say:16:1421128013:1.text: Imperator Ravion, as a reformist, was far less aggressive and more open-minded than the other nobles.
say:16:1421128013:1.source_cn: 沙利叶大人主张改革，手段也相对温和，所以已经是最好说话...

say:17:1421128014:1.text: I suppose you've got a rough idea of the trial by now. It's time for a break.
say:17:1421128014:1.source_cn: 你们体会得也差不多了，我们找个地方休息片刻吧。

choice:6:0:1.text: This round was tough as well.
choice:6:0:1.male: This round was tough as well.
choice:6:0:1.female: This round was tough as well.

say:0:1421130001:0.text: I wonder what type of mission affected Indris this much?
say:0:1421130001:0.source_cn: 对因度厄大人影响很大的任务？会是什么呢？

say:2:1421131001:1.text:
Is this a... grave?
Weren't we talking about a mission that affected Indris' whole career? What are we doing here?
say:2:1421131001:1.source_cn: 这里是……坟墓？\n不是说，这是对因度厄大人影响很大的...

say:3:1421131002:1.text: Hear me out first—Indris' very first mission was to deal with severely corrupted Essail.
say:3:1421131002:1.source_cn: 是的，因度厄接受的第一个任务，就是去处理严重孽化的艾塞勒。

say:4:1421131003:1.text: That was his first time taking a life. Imperator Ravion reassured him that the corrupted were no different from beasts, but...
say:4:1421131003:1.source_cn: 那是他第一次杀人，尽管沙利叶大人安慰他，说孽化的家伙已...

say:5:1421131004:1.text: The idea still didn't sit well with him, did it?
say:5:1421131004:1.source_cn: 但，因度厄大人是不可能接受这种安慰的吧？

say:6:1421131005:1.text: After all, he was a commoner who had to fight tooth and nail just to survive!
say:6:1421131005:1.source_cn: 因为他是从那些从野兽口中争食，性命比一把长弓还便宜的平...

say:7:1421131006:1.text: He cherished life, so he could never see it as something to be snuffed out so easily...
say:7:1421131006:1.source_cn: 他知道人命的意义，他也不会把人的生命当成，当成能够轻易...

say:8:1421131007:1.text: You understand him, Otivia, but not entirely.
say:8:1421131007:1.source_cn: 你已经很了解他了，欧蒂薇，但还不够。

say:9:1421131008:1.text: He had to continue down the blood-stained path until he gained the power to uphold the sanctity of life.
say:9:1421131008:1.source_cn: 为了能够拥有不把人的性命轻而视之的资格，他就必须要心怀...

say:10:1421131009:1.text: That was the price he had to pay... Perhaps this spirit was what the Imperator saw in him all along.
say:10:1421131009:1.source_cn: 这是他进入这道门槛所必须付出的代价……也是沙利叶大人选...

choice_prompt:11:1421131009.text: That was the price he had to pay... Perhaps this spirit was what the Imperator saw in him all along.
choice_prompt:11:1421131009.source_cn: 这是他进入这道门槛所必须付出的代价……也是沙利叶大人选择他的原因。

say:12:1421131010:1.text: The bodies of the corrupted had to be handled separately, and commoners were simply cremated.
say:12:1421131010:1.source_cn: 嗯。而且，原本孽化的尸首都会被单独处理，如果身份低贱，...

say:13:1421131011:1.text: The commoner on his first mission should have been cremated as well, but the Imperator got him a grave at Indris' request.
say:13:1421131011:1.source_cn: 这家伙是个平民，本来应该尸骨无存的，但在因度厄的请求下...

say:14:1421131012:1.text: Indris would occasionally come back to visit this grave. He said it was to mourn, but I suppose he was trying to seek repentance...
say:14:1421131012:1.source_cn: 在那之后，因度厄偶尔就会过来。他自己说是致哀，但或许也...

say:15:1421131013:1.text: ... We should all take a moment to mourn for this unfortunate soul too.
say:15:1421131013:1.source_cn: ……我们，也为这位不幸的人默哀吧。

choice:11:0:1.text: Ravion wanted him to know that.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 这才是沙利叶的安慰吧
choice:11:0:1.male: Ravion wanted him to know that.
choice:11:0:1.female: Ravion wanted him to know that.

say:2:1421132001:1.text: I'm glad things have now taken a turn for the better, as we've found a way to purify the Sinned Ones...
say:2:1421132001:1.source_cn: 如今，我们有了新的希望。孽化者可以不再存在……

say:3:1421132002:1.text: Those unaffected are free to venture to the surface and enjoy the warmth of the sun...
say:3:1421132002:1.source_cn: 其他的人还能前往地面上，去沐浴真正的阳光……

say:4:1421132003:1.text: Tragedies like this will never happen again.
say:4:1421132003:1.source_cn: 所以，像这样的悲剧，应该不会再次发生了。

say:5:1421132004:1.text: Everyone, I think I've figured out the second verse for my poem.
say:5:1421132004:1.source_cn: 我想好了，第二段的吟游诗句。

say:6:1421132005:1.text: Honestly, I assumed the rest of Indris' life would unfold into yet another thrilling hero story at first.
say:6:1421132005:1.source_cn: 在知道因度厄大人是创造了前所未有历史的出色战士时，我原...

say:7:1421132006:1.text: Of course, it's important to highlight how he passed the guard trial with such finesse.
say:7:1421132006:1.source_cn: 当然了，我也会尽量描述因度厄大人战斗和接受测试的英姿！

say:8:1421132007:1.text: However, we mustn't leave out the harshness of the world he had to navigate as well.
say:8:1421132007:1.source_cn: 但，我想，在这英姿之外，我必须要加上当时那沉重而残酷的...

say:9:1421132008:1.text: I wouldn't want my poem to give the impression that Indris is just another warrior glorified by the nobles.
say:9:1421132008:1.source_cn: 不这样的话，因度厄大人就和贵族宣扬过的那些所谓战士毫无...

choice_prompt:10:1421132008.text: I wouldn't want my poem to give the impression that Indris is just another warrior glorified by the nobles.
choice_prompt:10:1421132008.source_cn: 不这样的话，因度厄大人就和贵族宣扬过的那些所谓战士毫无区别了。

say:11:1421132009:1.text: Exactly. The value of life meant nothing, as the people only cared about money—that's how cold and ruthless the world was back then.
say:11:1421132009:1.source_cn: 是的，不是价值，而是价格，就是这样的冷漠与残酷。
say:11:1421132009:1.male: Exactly. The value of life meant nothing, as the people only cared about money—that's how cold and ruthless the world was back then.
say:11:1421132009:1.female: Exactly. The value of life meant nothing, as the people only cared about money—that's how cold and ruthless the world was back then.

narration:13:1421132011:0.text: Her brow furrowed in concentration, Otivia carefully composes the second verse, selecting every word with precision.
narration:13:1421132011:0.source_cn: 欧蒂薇神色严肃，句斟字酌地写下了第二段诗句。

say:14:1421132012:1.text: Second verse: The Rising Star. Alright, that's done!
say:14:1421132012:1.source_cn: 嗯，第二段，脱颖而出的利箭——完成！

say:15:1421132013:1.text: What should I write for the next verse?
say:15:1421132013:1.source_cn: 接下来，接下来写点什么好呢？

say:16:1421132014:1.text: What? I thought two verses were all you needed.
say:16:1421132014:1.source_cn: 什么？两段还不够你写的？

say:17:1421132015:1.text: They were just the opening! The most moving part is yet to come!
say:17:1421132015:1.source_cn: 不够不够！现在才刚开始，最动人心弦的部分还没有到！

say:18:1421132016:1.text: I have to keep going! Hmm... let's dive into his life as a guard this time! Who should we turn to this time?
say:18:1421132016:1.source_cn: 我得继续！嗯……就从他在卫队的生活开始吧！先找谁打听这...

choice_prompt:19:1421132016.text: I have to keep going! Hmm... let's dive into his life as a guard this time! Who should we turn to this time?
choice_prompt:19:1421132016.source_cn: 我得继续！嗯……就从他在卫队的生活开始吧！先找谁打听这部分呢？

choice:19:0:1.text: The person is right in front of you.
choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 你面前就有合适的人选
choice:19:0:1.male: The person is right in front of you.
choice:19:0:1.female: The person is right in front of you.

say:22:1421132010:1.text: What some take for granted is forever out of reach for others. So much for fairness and equality...
say:22:1421132010:1.source_cn: 有些人习以为常的事实，对另一些人来说是可望而不可即的高...
say:22:1421132010:1.male: What some take for granted is forever out of reach for others. So much for fairness and equality...
say:22:1421132010:1.female: What some take for granted is forever out of reach for others. So much for fairness and equality...

say:2:1421133001:1.text: As a kid, Indris already stood out, and as a young man, he proved himself a cut above the rest. Isn't that enough to make him a legend?
say:2:1421133001:1.source_cn: 少年时期的与众不同，青年时期的脱颖而出，作为传奇已经够了吧？

say:3:1421133002:1.text: That's far from enough! Besides, I already know what to write for the next verse...
say:3:1421133002:1.source_cn: 那怎么行！我都想好了下面一段——

say:4:1421133003:1.text: It'll be about how Indris found his footing among the guards and went on to make his own mark!
say:4:1421133003:1.source_cn: 因度厄大人在卫队中站稳脚跟后，大展拳脚的故事！

say:5:1421133004:1.text: Can't say I know much about that part of his life. We're colleagues, but we mostly kept to our own business.
say:5:1421133004:1.source_cn: 这个，你问我我也不算特别清楚，我们毕竟是同僚，平时也是...

say:6:1421133005:1.text: I'm afraid only Imperator Ravion can help you... You want me to take you to him, don't you?
say:6:1421133005:1.source_cn: 你这些要说的话也只有沙利叶大人才知……你就是想让我带你...

say:7:1421133006:1.text: Come on, just help me out this once, Xera! I have no idea where to find the Imperator, and even if I did, he might not even see me!
say:7:1421133006:1.source_cn: 拜托了，拜托了席蕾！我根本找不到沙利叶大人，他也不一定...

say:8:1421133007:1.text: And Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know the Imperator quite well, don't you? Could you be a gem and put in a good word for me?
say:8:1421133007:1.male: And Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know the Imperator quite well, don't you? Could you be a gem and put in a good word for me?
say:8:1421133007:1.female: And Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know the Imperator quite well, don't you? Could you be a gem and put in a good word for me?

choice_prompt:9:1421133007.text: And Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know the Imperator quite well, don't you? Could you be a gem and put in a good word for me?
choice_prompt:9:1421133007.source_cn: 还有<style=stress><player_name></style>大人，拜托了拜托了，我最爱你了！你也跟沙利叶大人很熟吧！
choice_prompt:9:1421133007.male: And Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know the Imperator quite well, don't you? Could you be a gem and put in a good word for me?
choice_prompt:9:1421133007.female: And Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know the Imperator quite well, don't you? Could you be a gem and put in a good word for me?

say:10:1421133008:1.text: Yay! Thanks a million! I'll make sure to give you a special acknowledgment at the end of the poem.
say:10:1421133008:1.source_cn: 耶！感谢支持，我会在诗句的最后鸣谢你的贡献。
say:10:1421133008:1.male: Yay! Thanks a million! I'll make sure to give you a special acknowledgment at the end of the poem.
say:10:1421133008:1.female: Yay! Thanks a million! I'll make sure to give you a special acknowledgment at the end of the poem.

say:11:1421133010:1.text: Ugh, fine! But don't think sweet-talking me will work every time!
say:11:1421133010:1.source_cn: ……真是的，别以为一撒娇我们就会答应你！下不为例！

say:12:1421133011:1.text: You want to meet the Imperator right now? I'll take you to him.
say:12:1421133011:1.source_cn: 不是要找沙利叶大人吗？我带你们过去。

choice:9:0:1.text: I'll see what I can do.
choice:9:0:1.male: I'll see what I can do.
choice:9:0:1.female: I'll see what I can do.

say:14:1421133009:1.text: Pretty, please! You're the absolute best, Xera!
say:14:1421133009:1.source_cn: 拜托！求求你了，席蕾你人最好啦！

say:0:1421134001:0.text: Going to meet Imperator Ravion... I'm feeling a bit nervous now...
say:0:1421134001:0.source_cn: 要去见沙利叶大人了吗，多少有些紧张啊……

say:0:1421136001:0.text: I can't wait to dish out some dirt on Indris while relaxing with a glass of wine!
say:0:1421136001:0.source_cn: 快去吧，我已经迫不及待地准备就着美酒说因度厄的独家坏话了！

say:3:1421137001:1.text: You must be Vernon. Imperator Ravion sent us here to collect some darkspring water.
say:3:1421137001:1.source_cn: 维恩先生，你好。我们是受沙利叶大人所托，来拿暗泉水的。

say:4:1421137002:1.text: I see, but I'm afraid the spring water isn't ready yet.
say:4:1421137002:1.source_cn: 原来如此。不过，我现在没办法直接给各位大人。

choice_prompt:5:1421137002.text: I see, but I'm afraid the spring water isn't ready yet.
choice_prompt:5:1421137002.source_cn: 原来如此。不过，我现在没办法直接给各位大人。

say:6:1421137003:1.text: Actually, it's my fault. Darkspring water can be used directly for brewing, but for fine wine, there's an extra step involved.
say:6:1421137003:1.source_cn: 唉，这其实是我的失误。普通的暗泉水可以直接酿酒，但如果...

say:7:1421137004:1.text: Let's cut to the chase—just tell us what we need to do.
say:7:1421137004:1.source_cn: 别卖关子了，直接说你需要什么帮助吧。

say:8:1421137005:1.text: Fair enough. Darkspring water has dark magic in it, so it needs to be cleansed first to mix better with the other ingredients.
say:8:1421137005:1.source_cn: 那我就不瞒着各位大人了，暗泉水有一定的黑暗魔法属性，如...

say:9:1421137006:1.text: The priest I usually work with has been quite busy lately, so this batch of darkspring water hasn't been cleansed...
say:9:1421137006:1.source_cn: 跟我长期合作的祭司大人最近有些忙碌，所以这批暗泉水还没...

say:10:1421137007:1.text: It just so happens that we have an outstanding mage here. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you up for it?
say:10:1421137007:1.source_cn: 你倒是找对人了，我们这里可有一位大魔法师在。<styl...
say:10:1421137007:1.male: It just so happens that we have an outstanding mage here. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you up for it?
say:10:1421137007:1.female: It just so happens that we have an outstanding mage here. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you up for it?

choice_prompt:11:1421137007.text: It just so happens that we have an outstanding mage here. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you up for it?
choice_prompt:11:1421137007.source_cn: 你倒是找对人了，我们这里可有一位大魔法师在。<style=stress><player_name></style>，如何？
choice_prompt:11:1421137007.male: It just so happens that we have an outstanding mage here. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you up for it?
choice_prompt:11:1421137007.female: It just so happens that we have an outstanding mage here. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you up for it?

say:12:1421137008:1.text: I don't know what to say! You're my customers, and You shouldn't have to help me with this.
say:12:1421137008:1.source_cn: 太感谢了！还得劳动客人自己动手，我真是有点不好意思了！
say:12:1421137008:1.male: I don't know what to say! You're my customers, and You shouldn't have to help me with this.
say:12:1421137008:1.female: I don't know what to say! You're my customers, and You shouldn't have to help me with this.

say:13:1421137009:1.text: Alright, enough with the pleasantries. We're in a rush, so let's get started.
say:13:1421137009:1.source_cn: 行了，别客套了。我们赶时间，准备开始吧。

say:4:1421138002:1.text: Thank you so much for your help! Here's the pure darkspring water.
say:4:1421138002:1.source_cn: 感谢您，大魔法师！这就是净化后的暗泉水了！
say:4:1421138002:1.male: Thank you so much for your help! Here's the pure darkspring water.
say:4:1421138002:1.female: Thank you so much for your help! Here's the pure darkspring water.

say:5:1421138003:1.text: Yes, we'll take it to go.

say:2:1421139001:1.text: Are you Sharoa? Sorry to bother you, but we're here to pick up some crystal salt.
say:2:1421139001:1.source_cn: 那个，莎露小姐，打扰一下！我们是来拿幻晶盐粉的。

say:4:1421139003:1.source_cn: 是沙利叶大人让我们来的。

say:5:1421139004:1.text: I see! But... my hands are full now, so you'll have to collect it yourselves.
say:5:1421139004:1.source_cn: 原来是沙利叶大人的预定！不过……我现在有点忙，你们自己...

say:6:1421139005:1.text: What you need is in a purple bag.

say:0:1421140001:0.source_cn: 暗泉水和幻晶盐粉，都齐了。

say:1:1421140002:0.text: Let's bring them to Imperator Ravion!
say:1:1421140002:0.source_cn: 那我们快去找沙利叶大人复命吧！

say:12:1421141002:1.text: Imperator, can you tell us about Captain Indris now...?
say:12:1421141002:1.source_cn: 所以，沙利叶大人你该告诉我们了吧，因度厄大人——

narration:14:1421141003:0.text: Otivia halts abruptly when Indris appears in the distance. Ravion doesn't hesitate—he shoves the whole group into a secluded corner.
